on_battle_start: Ahoy! Ready to walk the plank, landlubber?
The tides are turning. Let's see if you can weather this storm.
on_battle_won: Ha! Back to the docks with ye. Come back when you've got sea legs.
The sea shows no mercy, and neither do I.
on_battle_lost: Shiver me timbers, you got me! Take the badge, captain.
Well sailed, trainer. The tides favor you today.
